resources.string: This message has an unknown format or conflicting facts. It will not affect your finances until resolved. Clear supported messages are processed automatically.
Some messages are processing or waiting for a retry. You do not need to redefine them.
Confirm the account or configure and link the card.
The transfer endpoints or matching need review.
This may be another notice for a saved transaction. Check before approving.
Some cases are pending. Displayed amounts and transactions cover confirmed activity only, not a final total for the period.
Some due or payment information is missing. Known details remain available; manage commitments in Settings.
Confirm this message is not a financial transaction. Your decision is saved and you can restore it later.
Your decision is saved. Retry applying it or review the changed details.
